baseline_raw_precheck.role: baseline side pinned at full precision before any variant number exists

chain_script_to_launch.launch_timing: only after the training chain has finished; one evaluation at a time, no concurrent GPU work

delta_source.rule: both sides recomputed through the same frozen COCOeval parameters; the delta comes from unrounded values; with fewer than three folds the deltas are still reported but no equal-weight mean is produced and the exit code is non-zero

on_stop: reason written to eval_chain.log and the chain exits non-zero; nothing already produced is removed or overwritten
step: evaluation of the reweight_l1 exploratory paired round
stop_conditions: training exit code file absent or non-zero
evaluation output directory / log / exit-code file already exists
paired-delta recomputation exits non-zero (rounding mismatch or missing fold)

superseded_chain_script.reason: it skipped a failed fold and continued, which does not match the convention that any failed step ends the run; kept on disk as the record of the change, never executed
